item.title: Murph learns your health in one easy ask
item.summary: After you say what you want from your health, Murph asks about your background in one go: how you move, what you take, the medical basics, your watch or ring, and recent blood tests. Send a voice memo or type it, and your first step is built from what you shared.
item.details: Say none or skip and it moves on. Say later about one thing and it won't hold you up. If you put off connecting a device, Murph leaves it alone until you bring it up.
